title: Boundaries and Testability in the Planning Workflow

execution.reason: Contract tests come first; the three surface edits touch disjoint files but share one test file for verification, so they are sequenced conservatively.

tasks.title: Lock Boundary and Testability Contracts
tasks.description: Focused tests express the conditional section, seam gate, gray-box record, observable-criteria, and corrected-seam contracts, and fail against the current unmodified surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Tests assert the Boundaries and Testability section is conditional, not an unconditional heading.
Tests assert the three-part seam gate: substitution need, enabling point, and a real alternative implementation.
Tests assert the gray-box exception record and verification-perspective vocabulary.
Tests assert PRD Success Criteria require observable behavior while Proposed Solution and Technical Context survive.
Tests assert the deep-module-design seam claim requires an enabling point.
New tests are appended without altering existing assertions in the file.

tasks.title: Add the Boundaries and Testability Plan Section
tasks.description: The plan prompt and planning skill both carry the conditional section, the three-part seam gate, the gray-box exception record, and verification-perspective vocabulary.
acceptance_criteria: The section lives inside the Phase 7 Required Plan Header block in .pi/prompts/plan.md.
The section is explicitly emitted only when a plan introduces or changes a module boundary.
The planning skill Plan Template carries the matching section.
Black-box and gray-box are labelled verification perspectives, not module-design categories.

tasks.title: Scope Observable Behavior to Acceptance Criteria
tasks.description: The PRD template requires Success Criteria to describe externally observable behavior while Proposed Solution and Technical Context remain untouched.
acceptance_criteria: Success Criteria requires externally observable behavior.
The Proposed Solution and Technical Context sections are unchanged.
No blanket black-box rule is applied to the whole PRD.

tasks.title: Correct the Absolute Seam Claim
tasks.description: The deep-module-design skill states that an interface becomes a test seam only when an enabling point can select another behavior.
acceptance_criteria: The skill no longer asserts unconditionally that the interface is the test seam.
The corrected wording requires an enabling point.
The rest of the skill is otherwise unchanged.

tasks.title: Verify Integrated Boundary Guidance
tasks.description: The full retained suite is green, every artifact graph validates, and the untouched templates are byte-identical to HEAD.
acceptance_criteria: The full retained suite passes with zero failures.
design.md, adr.md, and tasks.md templates are byte-identical to HEAD.
verification: for f in .pi/artifacts/*/tasks.json; do node --experimental-strip-types .pi/scripts/task-graph.ts validate "$f"; done
